theme_and_archetype.vibe: Grounded, natural, warm, and highly functional. A harmonious blend of an artful e-commerce storefront and a high-density, precise ERP dashboard.

color_palette.strategy: Warm sand, bone-white bases with moss, clay, and terracotta accents. High contrast for readability without clinical starkness. No generic tech blue or purple.

typography.anti_default_rule: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans are BANNED.

storefront.grid: MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID. Asymmetrical layouts, overlapping elements, negative space. Avoid standard Bootstrap columns.
storefront.hero: Full height or large container. Hero image overlay max bg-black/30 or gradient to transparent. Never fully obscure the image.
storefront.cards: Avoid rigid Shadcn cards. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for organic overlapping, fluid image containers.

dashboard.spacing: Dense. Use p-4, p-6. Tight gaps.
dashboard.grid: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID. Data correlation, strict hierarchy. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4.
dashboard.cards: Cardless or subtle roundness (max 8px). 1px border. No heavy soft shadows. Use sharp inner contrasts.
dashboard.navigation: Sidebar for modules. Top bar for search and profile.

component_rules.buttons: Storefront: Large, rounded-full or pill-shaped, primary or terracotta. Dashboard: Compact, subtle radius (rounded-md), functional.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, but strip tech-look. Tint borders with warm gray (border-[#E5E1D8]). Focus states must be highly visible (ring-2 ring-primary/50).
component_rules.tables: Dashboard: Shadcn Table. Zebra striping with subtle #F9F8F6, sharp borders, mono font for numeric data.
component_rules.modals: Backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl), glassmorphism only if it feels premium, otherwise solid #FFFFFF with sharp 1px border.
component_rules.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Use earthy palettes (Moss green, Terracotta, Clay) instead of default colors.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use Lucide React for consistent line icons across both storefront and dashboard. Keep stroke width at 1.5 for a premium feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The tech stack uses JavaScript (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript. Do not create .ts or .tsx files.
MANDATORY: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='checkout-submit-button').
STOREFRONT: Create an immersive experience. Do not just use a grid of cards for products. Use asymmetrical bento grids, large elegant typography, and generous padding (p-12 to p-24).
DASHBOARD: Strict, dense, function-first layout. Use a sidebar. Tables must be legible, use monospace fonts for SKUs and Prices.
COLOR: Adhere strictly to the warm sand/moss green palette. Do not inject default tailwind blue or indigo.
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA (min 4.5:1). Provide distinct focus states for all inputs.
